name: io.github.Rixtayz/mail-mcp
title: Mail-MCP
description: Personal Outlook (Outlook.com, Hotmail, Live, MSN): read, search, file, delete, unsubscribe.

environmentVariables.name: MAIL_MCP_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Application (client) ID of your own Microsoft Entra app registration. Leave unset to use the built-in Mail-MCP app.

environmentVariables.name: MAIL_MCP_CACHE_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Absolute path of the token cache file. Unset or empty: ~/.mail-mcp/token-cache.json. On macOS and Linux, the sign-in is not saved in a folder that belongs to another user or that other users can write to.
